name: Beast (baseline)
notes: Baseline for four-legged hunters: Briar Wolves, the fixture hound, wharf rats (scaled down). Hearing and smell dominant: a 20 dB threshold hears a crouched step that a guard misses, out to 40 m, and scent reaches 15 m in still air, farther downwind, following trails. Eyes are set to the side, so a narrow 30° focus but a wide 110° periphery that catches movement; they fall off sooner (18 m) than a guard's. Dark vision 0.6: night hunters see in dim light but not in pitch black, so torches and fire still matter (canon: wolves are scared by fire). Detection speed 1.25: quick to react to what they do notice.
